title: Nio UDP dropping bytes
body:
On netflow.io we noticed that when using Nio for UDP, it drops almost half of the bytes per Datagram.

I have written an example:

```
package io.netflow

import io.netty.buffer._
import io.netty.bootstrap._
import io.netty.channel._
import io.netty.channel.socket.oio._
import io.netty.channel.socket.DatagramPacket
import io.netty.logging._
import java.net.{ InetAddress, InetSocketAddress }

object Server extends App { PS =>
  override def main(args: Array[String]) { start() }

  def start() {
    println("Starting up")

    InternalLoggerFactory.setDefaultFactory(new Slf4JLoggerFactory())

    var srv: Bootstrap = new Bootstrap
    val addr = new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getByName("0.0.0.0"), 2055)
    val chan = srv.group(new OioEventLoopGroup)
      .localAddress(addr)
      .channel(classOf[OioDatagramChannel])
      .handler(TrafficHandler)
      .option[java.lang.Integer](ChannelOption.SO_RCVBUF, 102400)
    srv.bind().sync
    println("Listening on %s:%s".format(addr.getAddress.getHostAddress, addr.getPort))

    println("Ready")

    // Add Shutdown Hook to cleanly shutdown Netty
    Runtime.getRuntime.addShutdownHook(new Thread {
      override def run() { PS.stop }
    })
  }

  private def stop() {
    println("Shutting down")
  }
}

object TrafficHandler extends ChannelInboundMessageHandlerAdapter[DatagramPacket] {

  override def exceptionCaught(ctx: ChannelHandlerContext, e: Throwable) {
    e.printStackTrace()
  }

  override def messageReceived(ctx: ChannelHandlerContext, msg: DatagramPacket) {
    println(msg.data.readableBytes)
  }
}
```

This code produces the following output:

```
[info] Running io.netflow.Server
Starting up
Listening on 0.0.0.0:2055
Ready
1392
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
1416
```

This is the correct length as reported by tcpdump.

As soon as you switch over to Nio: (just replaced Oio with Nio and oio with nio)

```
package io.netflow

import io.netty.buffer._
import io.netty.bootstrap._
import io.netty.channel._
import io.netty.channel.socket.nio._
import io.netty.channel.socket.DatagramPacket
import io.netty.logging._
import java.net.{ InetAddress, InetSocketAddress }

object Server extends App { PS =>
  override def main(args: Array[String]) { start() }

  def start() {
    println("Starting up")

    InternalLoggerFactory.setDefaultFactory(new Slf4JLoggerFactory())

    var srv: Bootstrap = new Bootstrap
    val addr = new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getByName("0.0.0.0"), 2055)
    val chan = srv.group(new NioEventLoopGroup)
      .localAddress(addr)
      .channel(classOf[NioDatagramChannel])
      .handler(TrafficHandler)
      .option[java.lang.Integer](ChannelOption.SO_RCVBUF, 102400)
    srv.bind().sync
    println("Listening on %s:%s".format(addr.getAddress.getHostAddress, addr.getPort))

    println("Ready")

    // Add Shutdown Hook to cleanly shutdown Netty
    Runtime.getRuntime.addShutdownHook(new Thread {
      override def run() { PS.stop }
    })
  }

  private def stop() {
    println("Shutting down")
  }
}

object TrafficHandler extends ChannelInboundMessageHandlerAdapter[DatagramPacket] {

  override def exceptionCaught(ctx: ChannelHandlerContext, e: Throwable) {
    e.printStackTrace()
  }

  override def messageReceived(ctx: ChannelHandlerContext, msg: DatagramPacket) {
    println(msg.data.readableBytes)
  }
}
```
